prompt_en: A photograph built around a small optical adjustment, made as a close environmental portrait of one 28-year-old adult woman in an evening industrial optical test bay. Use the supplied photograph as a face-and-hair appearance reference: a chin-length dark bob with fine strands across the forehead, large brown eyes, natural pink lips and a softly oval facial contour. Her arms and legs read long relative to her torso. Her shoulders and pelvis form a narrow lateral frame, with slim upper arms and thighs. Shallow elongated muscular contours trace her exposed upper arms and forearms, with fine tendon lines beside the wrists. Her torso reference length remains readable beside elongated arms and legs of slender limb widths; the same adult subject and named body region keep continuous connections from shoulders through elbows to wrists and from hips through knees to ankles. She wears a fitted petrol-blue sleeveless rib-knit top, close dark shorts and low dark shoes. A large vertical segmented mirror sits in its circular gimbal behind her, its pale facets catching distant work lights. Two low controls project forward beside her hips. She pauses just after positioning a small optical component, which now sits flush in its rim-mounted bracket. Her left fingertips touch a small fixed latch on the lower rim; her right thumb and index finger rest against a separate brass adjustment wheel. Her hands stay separated at either side of her waist, with both elbows in an easy bend. Both feet rest flat on the concrete floor and her weight remains centered. She gives the camera a relaxed, brief glance, lips resting softly apart, while her fingertips remain in place. Warm work lamps graze her face and arms against a cool light strip across the bay. A vertical 2:3 frame contains her complete figure from hair to both shoe soles at nearly nine tenths of frame height. A chest-height camera and near-frontal view keep the face, lateral body outline and both hand contacts clearly resolved with natural perspective. The face and gentle hand contact lead the image; the mirrored ring supplies a quiet circular counterpoint to her elongated figure.
